screen.name: Your Business
lines: What you sell, in plain words

slides.text: Day 1: make your bio say what you sell and where to buy it.
Day 2: post a Reel that answers one question your buyer asks.
Day 3: post a carousel that teaches one thing.
Day 4: show the work in Stories, with a link sticker.

chat.text: A question about what you sell

slides.text: Day 5: reply to every comment and message from someone interested.
Day 6: repost your best Reel with a new hook.
Day 7: see which post got the most link taps, then make another like it.
The $1K Challenge turns this into 30 days, with a plan for each week. Link in bio.

caption: Want the 30-day version? It's the $1K Challenge, link in bio. Organic traffic comes from doing a few things on repeat: a clear bio, posts that answer real questions, and an easy way to click through. Link taps are in your Insights, and they tell you which posts send people to your page.
